```lean
theorem lg_target {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Set Ω) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : μ Aᶜ = 1 - μ A := by
  have h_μ_Ω : μ Set.univ = 1 := MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure.univ_measure μ
  have h_A_complement : MeasurableSet Aᶜ := by apply MeasurableSet.compl hA
  have h_additivity : μ A + μ Aᶜ = μ (A ∪ Aᶜ) :=
    MeasureTheory.measure_add_of_disjoint μ hA h_A_complement
  have h_union_eq_Ω : A ∪ Aᶜ = Set.univ := by simp
  have h_sum_eq_1 : μ A + μ Aᶜ = 1 :=
    calc μ A + μ Aᶜ = μ (A ∪ Aᶜ) := h_additivity
      ... = μ Set.univ := by rw h_union_eq_Ω
      ... = 1 := h_μ_Ω
  rw [h_sum_eq_1]
  ring
```
